business_problem: Dassault Systèmes needed to speed trusted simulation, move compliance checks earlier, and help aerospace and automotive customers make design decisions faster without sacrificing predictive accuracy or information sovereignty.
solution_summary: Dassault Systèmes combined its 3DEXPERIENCE platform and SIMULIA AI-driven Virtual Twin of Physics Behavior with NVIDIA CUDA-X, NVIDIA PhysicsNeMo, NVIDIA Omniverse, and NVIDIA Nemotron open models to speed simulation and compliance workflows. Engineering data, 3D models, domain rules, and certification requirements stay connected inside 3DEXPERIENCE, where virtual twins preserve engineering context. CUDA-X and PhysicsNeMo accelerate multiphysics and physics-informed AI runs so teams can predict outcomes near real time instead of relying on slower traditional simulation loops. Omniverse libraries support industrial virtual-twin and AI-simulation applications, while Nemotron-powered virtual companions surface design and compliance guidance earlier in the workflow. NIAR uses the stack to align aircraft virtual twins with means of compliance, and Lucid Motors uses the same architecture to move vehicle programs from concept to production faster without losing predictive accuracy.
